messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 6):
"""
It is a document provided by the Insurer along with the policy document that explains in simple words, basic features of a policy at one place. The CIS shall a) be provided to every policyholder in case of both Individual Insurance policy holder as well as a Member of Group Insurance Policy. b) have details like i. type of insurance, ii. sum Insured, iii. coverage provided, iv. summary of exclusions which policy does not cover, v. sub-limits (a pre-defined limit above which insurance company will not pay), vi. deductibles (specified amount upto which an insurance company will not pay any claim/which will be deducted from total claim, if the claim amount is more than the specified amount), vii. waiting period(s) (time period during which specified diseases/ treatments are not covered), and viii. certain important things such as Free Look Period, Policy Renewal, Migration, Portability and Moratorium Period. c) contain information regarding the Claims Procedure, Policy Servicing and Grievance Redressal Mechanism including contact details of Insurance Ombudsman
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Who must receive the CIS document when a new health insurance policy is issued?","answer":"Every policyholder, whether an individual or a member of a group insurance policy, must receive the CIS document.","facts":["be provided to every policyholder in case of both Individual Insurance policy holder as well as a Member of Group Insurance Policy","It is a document provided by the Insurer along with the policy document"]},{"question":"What key information must the CIS include about claim handling and grievance redressal?","answer":"The CIS must contain information regarding the Claims Procedure, Policy Servicing and Grievance Redressal Mechanism, including contact details of the Insurance Ombudsman.","facts":["contain information regarding the Claims Procedure, Policy Servicing and Grievance Redressal Mechanism including contact details of Insurance Ombudsman"]}]}
